detailed_description: The JavaScript Minifier compresses pasted JavaScript code in the browser by removing comments, extra whitespace, line breaks, and unnecessary spaces around common operators and punctuation. It shows the original size, minified size, and estimated size reduction after you run the minifier, then lets you copy the generated output. It is a lightweight helper for quick code cleanup and size checks before pasting code into a build step, snippet, or test page.
usage_steps: Paste JavaScript code into the input textarea.
Click the Minify button to generate a compact output.
Review the original size, minified size, and size reduction statistics.
Copy the minified JavaScript from the output textarea.
usage_examples: Example 1: A developer pastes a short JavaScript snippet to remove comments and extra spacing before using it in a demo page.
Example 2: A front-end engineer checks how much a small inline script can be reduced before adding it to a static HTML file.
Example 3: A learner compares readable JavaScript with the compact output to understand what simple minification changes.
Example 4: A maintainer cleans up a copied legacy snippet and copies the minified result for a quick test.
